messages:
devon: heads up — during the 02:14 deploy a debug log printed what looks like a full customer API token from the payments service. snippet below, putting raw line here for triage.

devon: ```
2026-03-15T02:14:36 ERROR payments-service: gateway call failed, body token=pk_live_abc123DEFghIJkLMN
error: timeout
```

mike: which environment was that in? prod/staging?

devon: prod only, pod payments-01. looks limited to an error-handling branch where we stringify the request for debugging. preliminary grep shows small count but need full scope.

anna: on it. quick question — those are merchant public keys (pk_*) or our internal secrets (sk_*)? that changes next steps.

devon: merchant public keys (pk_*), but merchants treat them as credentials. we should treat as sensitive for comms.

mike: immediate actions I'm doing now: 1) push hotfix to remove stringify debug (will deploy) 2) start log purge for last 24h from ephemeral bucket 3) run full grep across prod logs for token patterns 4) flag payments team to advise merchant rotation. will report counts.

sre-oncall: please add retention and storage locations for the grep results — don't leave copies in long-term S3.

devon: grep started, so far ~23 matches in last 6 hours, all from payments-01. saving results to ephemeral workspace only.

carla: heads-up for comms: don't draft external notices yet. legal review required. CC @legal on the affected merchant list when you have it.

legal: will review. send list + sample logs (redacted of anything other than merchant id and timestamp). we need to decide on consumer notification vs targeted merchant outreach.

anna: recommended severity: P1 for privacy exposure of merchant credentials — escalate to incident manager if merchant rotation is required.

mike: agreed to escalate. rolling back the deploy while we triage, and will open an incident ticket with action items.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: payments-service rollback -> payments-service@2026-03-15T02:20:12 by mike

devon: quick operational note — logs were not forwarded to external partners, only internal CloudWatch and a short-lived S3 staging bucket (retention 7d). still need S3 purge and a check for any archived snapshots.

mike: purge in progress for staging-s3://prod-logs/payments/2026-03-15, and I'm running an index query for any snapshots backed up to Glacier.

carla: once you have the merchant list, I'll draft customer-facing copy and loop in account managers. keep it targeted to affected merchants only, per legal.

legal: confirmed — no public post at this time. targeted merchant notification template approved pending final list and confirmation of rotation guidance.

sre-oncall: assign follow-ups: rotate-if-needed (payments), confirm purge, supply merchant list to legal/comms, postmortem to include root cause and mitigation (masking and stricter logging lint).

devon: thanks. final note: we should add a lint rule to CI to fail on `stringify(request)` in production builds. I'll open a PR.

mike: PRs and follow-ups noted in incident ticket INF-2026-0315-01. I'll update channel when purge + rotation guidance are complete.

devon: will paste final merchant IDs here as soon as grep finishes. thanks everyone.
